name: depscan
description: Escáner de dependencias vulnerables (npm y PyPI) basado en OSV y NVD

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core apps/cli apps/api && npm run build -w @depscan/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core apps/cli apps/api && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run build:server && concurrently -n tsc,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "tsc -b apps/api --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @depscan/api" "npm run dev -w @depscan/web"
